features.title: Identity capture form
features.description: Web form allowing a new customer to enter personal and identity details required to begin account opening.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can enter name, date of birth, address, and government ID number
Form validates required fields before submission
Submitted data is persisted and linked to a new application record

metadata.reasoning: Directly derived from acceptance criterion 'Customer can submit identity details online'.
metadata.citation: EP-01: 'Customer can submit identity details online'
metadata.trajectory: Stable once launched; may later add address auto-complete.

features.title: Document upload & validation
features.description: Allows the customer to upload verification documents (ID scan, proof of address) with basic format and size validation.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can upload one or more documents
System validates file type and size before accepting upload
Uploaded documents are linked to the customer's application

metadata.reasoning: Directly derived from acceptance criterion 'Customer can upload supporting documents'.
metadata.trajectory: May be extended with OCR-assisted validation in a later release.

features.title: Compliance review workflow
features.description: Gives a compliance officer a queue of submitted applications to review, approve, or reject.
acceptance_criteria: Compliance officer can view a queue of pending applications
Officer can approve or reject an application with a reason
Decision is recorded against the application record

metadata.reasoning: Directly derived from acceptance criterion 'Compliance officer can review and approve or reject submissions'.
metadata.citation: EP-01: 'Compliance officer can review and approve or reject submissions'
metadata.trajectory: Stable; potential future addition of automated risk scoring.

features.title: Application status notifications
features.description: Notifies the customer by email/SMS as their application moves through submission, review, and decision states.
acceptance_criteria: Customer receives a notification on submission
Customer receives a notification on approval or rejection
Notification includes next steps if rejected

metadata.reasoning: Derived from acceptance criterion 'Customer receives status notifications throughout the process'; channel details inferred as standard email/SMS.
metadata.citation: EP-01: 'Customer receives status notifications throughout the process'
metadata.trajectory: May expand to in-app notifications later.
